text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Kuwait's press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah receives a message from the emir of Bahrain.
- Iran's ambassador to Kuwait says Tehran seeks peaceful coexistence with other countries in the region.
- Total trade value at Arab stock markets rose 176 percent to $25 billion in 1996, official says.
- Kuwait studies a proposal to allow Kuwaitis living abroad to vote in general elections.
- Kuwait is under no current threat, defence minister says.
- The Kuwait Stock Exchange slips in active trade on Wednesday.
